name: Rearranged Desk
text: Before bidding, you may move one of your Engraving sigils to a chosen card in your hand.
archetypes: While Held, High Card, Kingmaker; any collection with card-bound sigils
decision: Which sigil to place where: a win payoff onto your surest winner, a losing payoff onto a card that will lose, or an affinity sigil onto a card it fits.
opponent: Hidden; opponents see only the results through play.
rationale: One placement a round turns a badly placed engraving into a well-placed one, worth a few points on average; the chosen card must have no sigil of its own, which keeps it distinct from Musical Chairs (GY-R02), which trades places with an engraved card.
deviation: Revision 1: replaced swapping the sigils on two chosen cards with placing one sigil where you choose.
